So, as I'm sure several user have noticed by now Voat's Submission Limit.

The current sitewide rule is as follows:(Paraphrased for this Subverse)

Each User is able to submit up to Ten Submissions per SubVerse per Twenty Four Hours.

This Thread was created with the intention of reaching out to the community for possible solutions to this issue, to discuss as to whether we should attempt to implement any solution, and to reach a consensus based on majority decision.

At the current time at least one Suggestion has been made in /v/ideasforvoat here. However, any of the suggestions made here would require some time to implement.

It is our constant goal to facilitate an enjoyable gameplay experience, and to do so by reaching out to the community.

Please express your opinion about this issue here.

-Civ5Sim Moderation Team

The only solution that the Moderation Team has been able to come up with so far is as follows:

Enable Players to create an alternate account. The rules for doing so would be as follows.

  1. You must already have an active Claim.

  2. The Username of the Alternate Account must have no more than a Two Character Difference*1.

  3. The Player must send a Private Message to the Moderators Requesting Verification of the Alternate Account**2.

  4. The Player must wait for Verification before attempting to Post as their Country.

  5. Each Player will be limited to One Alternate.

*1 A Two Character Difference is defined as "The Changing of Existing Characters, The Removal of a Character, or the Addition of a New Character.

*2 This Process Would be as follows: The Player Must send A PM to a moderator explaining their request for an Alternate, including the Username of The Alternate in question. The Moderator will then PM the Alternate Account a Six Digit Code. Lastly, the Original Acccount will PM the Moderator the Six Digit Code.

We hope that this temporary solution will enable players to have more posts each day.

Risks and Concerns:

One: "Cheating". This one is simple, User Flair is Manually Updated, so abusing the system by attempting to skip the verification process is impossible.

Two: "Claiming Multiple Territories". **This is already against the Rules. ** A user may not Claim multiple territories through the usage of Alts. If you are caught, following a warning, this is a bannable offense.

Three: Three is a more legitimate concern. If you're still with me at this point, I'm assuming you're interested enough to get to the real reason that we're seeking community input.

With the current Voat API Automatic User Flairing is not possible. Obviously we've worked around this, but not without an unavoidable downside.

Each Subverse CSS StyleSheet has a Character Limit.

Due to the inability to automate the User Flair functionality, it had to be implemented via CSS.

This means each additional Player brings us closer to the SubVerse Character Limit.

If you're following along you may have realized the conclusion.

This Subverse, and all those like it, have a "Carrying Capacity".

This is currently unavoidable. Four days ago Atko mentioned that he would work additional User Flair capabilities. This may or may not be a solution. In addition, there was no implication that it was a priority. Therefor it is most likely up to a User to make a pull request to Atko if they have an implementable solution.

Currently thehivemind is working in the Voat Beta on several API changes for the benefit of this SubVerse. (Many of which will be beneficial to all SubVerses) However, this will undoubtedly take a significant amount of time.

If we were to allow Alternates to be Flaired, it would lower our "Carrying Capacity" as if it was an additional Player.

Therefor I ask the community, is there a better solution? Is "No Solution" optimal at this time, or should we begin discussing with the community how to implement this solution?

If you're still with me, thanks for your time.

-MechaHitler
